    58	function disableAutomaticFontScaling(Component) {
    59	  Component.defaultProps = Component.defaultProps || {};

    67	async function applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme({ dimStatusBar = false } = {}) {
    68	  if (Platform.OS !== "android") return;
    69	
    70	  try {
    71	    StatusBar.setHidden(false);
    72	    StatusBar.setTranslucent(false);
    73	    StatusBar.setBackgroundColor(
    74	      dimStatusBar ? androidStatusBarDimmedColor : androidNavigationBarColor,
    75	      true,
    76	    );
    77	    StatusBar.setBarStyle(androidStatusBarStyle, true);
    78	  } catch {}
    79	
    80	  try {
    81	    await NavigationBar.setVisibilityAsync("visible");
    82	  } catch {}
    83	
    84	  try {
    85	    await NavigationBar.setButtonStyleAsync(androidNavigationBarButtonStyle);
    86	  } catch {}
    87	}
    88	
    89	function AndroidNavigationBarTint({ dimStatusBar = false, pathname }) {
    90	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    91	
    92	  useEffect(() => {
    93	    if (Platform.OS !== "android") return undefined;
    94	
    95	    const applyTheme = () => applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme({ dimStatusBar });
    96	
    97	    applyTheme();
    98	    const restoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 250);
    99	    const finalRestoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 1000);
   100	    const appStateSubscription = AppState.addEventListener("change", (state) => {
   101	      if (state === "active") {
   102	        applyTheme();
   103	      }
   104	    });
   105	    let visibilitySubscription;
   106	
   107	    try {
   108	      visibilitySubscription = NavigationBar.addVisibilityListener(
   109	        applyTheme,
   110	      );
   111	    } catch {}
   112	
   113	    return () => {
   114	      clearTimeout(restoreTimer);
   115	      clearTimeout(finalRestoreTimer);
   116	      appStateSubscription.remove();
   117	      visibilitySubscription?.remove();
   118	    };
   119	  }, [dimStatusBar, pathname]);
   120	
   121	  if (Platform.OS !== "android" || insets.bottom <= 0) {
   122	    return null;
   123	  }
   124	
   125	  return (
   126	    <View
   127	      pointerEvents="none"
   128	      style={{
   129	        position: "absolute",
   130	        left: 0,
   131	        right: 0,
   132	        bottom: 0,
   133	        height: insets.bottom,
   134	        borderTopWidth: androidNavigationBarHairlineWidth,
   135	        borderTopColor: androidNavigationBarHairlineColor,
   136	        backgroundColor: androidNavigationBarColor,
   137	        zIndex: 1000001,
   138	        elevation: 1000001,
   139	      }}
   140	    />
   141	  );
   142	}
   143	
   144	function AndroidStatusBarTint({ dimmed = false }) {
   145	  const height =
   146	    Platform.OS === "android" && Number.isFinite(StatusBar.currentHeight)
   147	      ? Math.max(0, StatusBar.currentHeight)
   148	      : 0;
   149	
   150	  if (height <= 0) {
   151	    return null;
   152	  }
   153	
   154	  return (
   155	    <View
   156	      pointerEvents="none"
   157	      style={{
   158	        position: "absolute",
   159	        top: 0,
   160	        left: 0,
   161	        right: 0,
   162	        height,
   163	        backgroundColor: androidNavigationBarColor,
   164	        zIndex: 1000002,
   165	        elevation: 1000002,
   166	      }}
   167	    >
   168	      {dimmed ? (
   169	        <View
   170	          pointerEvents="none"
   171	          style={{
   172	            position: "absolute",
   173	            top: 0,
   174	            right: 0,
   175	            bottom: 0,
   176	            left: 0,
   177	            backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
   178	          }}
   179	        />
   180	      ) : null}
   181	    </View>
   182	  );
   183	}

   185	function RootLayoutContent({ headerScrollY }) {
   186	  const pathname = usePathname();
   187	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
   188	  const backgroundHeroState = useBackgroundHeroState();
   189	  const { cartOverlayActionRequest, isShopOverlayVisible } = useShopCart();
   190	  const screenSwipe = useHeaderSwipe();
   191	  const topSafeInset = getTopSafeInset(insets);
   192	
   193	  const showPersistentHeader = pathname !== "/shop";
   194	
   195	  const useOverlayHeader =
   196	    pathname === "/" ||
   197	    pathname === "/products" ||
   198	    pathname === "/aboutus" ||
   199	    pathname === "/contact";
   200	
   201	  const shouldProtectBackgroundHero =
   202	    useOverlayHeader &&
   203	    Boolean(screenSwipe?.isActive || backgroundHeroState?.isFrozen);
   204	  const backgroundHeroLayerDepth = shouldProtectBackgroundHero ? 100 : 0;
   205	  const screenFadeTopOffset = pathname === "/shop"
   206	    ? 120 + topSafeInset
   207	    : 84 + topSafeInset;
   208	  const shouldShowScreenFade =
   209	    !(pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible);
   210	  const shouldShowCartOpeningDim =
   211	    cartOverlayActionRequest.pending && pathname !== "/shop";
   212	  const shouldDimAndroidStatusBar =
   213	    Platform.OS === "android" && pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible;
   214	
   215	  return (
   216	    <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: "#FFFCF2" }}>
   217	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   218	        <View
   219	          pointerEvents="none"
   220	          style={{
   221	            position: "absolute",
   222	            top: 0,
   223	            left: 0,
   224	            right: 0,
   225	            zIndex: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   226	            elevation: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   227	          }}
   228	        >
   229	          <AppHeader scrollY={headerScrollY} showOnlyHero />
   230	        </View>
   231	      ) : null}
   232	
   233	      <MainScreenPushFrame>
   234	        <Stack
   235	          screenOptions={{
   236	            headerShown: false,
   237	            animation: "none",
   238	            contentStyle: {
   239	              backgroundColor: useOverlayHeader
   240	                ? "transparent"
   241	                : "#FFFCF2",
   242	            },
   243	          }}
   244	        />
   245	      </MainScreenPushFrame>
   246	
   247	      {shouldShowScreenFade ? (
   248	        <ScreenFade
   249	          showTopFade={!useOverlayHeader}
   250	          topOffset={screenFadeTopOffset}
   251	        />
   252	      ) : null}
   253	
   254	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   255	        <View
   256	          pointerEvents="box-none"
   257	          style={{
   258	            position: "absolute",
   259	            top: 0,
   260	            left: 0,
   261	            right: 0,
   262	            zIndex: 1000000,
   263	            elevation: 1000000,
   264	          }}
   265	        >
   266	          <AppHeader scrollY={headerScrollY} showHero={false} />
   267	        </View>
   268	      ) : null}
   269	
   270	      {showPersistentHeader && !useOverlayHeader ? (
   271	        <AppHeader scrollY={headerScrollY} />
   272	      ) : null}
   273	
   274	      {shouldShowCartOpeningDim ? (
   275	        <View
   276	          pointerEvents="none"
   277	          style={{
   278	            position: "absolute",
   279	            top: 0,
   280	            right: 0,
   281	            bottom: 0,
   282	            left: 0,
   283	            backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
   284	            zIndex: 1000001,
   285	            elevation: 1000001,
   286	          }}
   287	        />
   288	      ) : null}
   289	
   290	      <StickyCartButton />
   291	
   292	      <AndroidStatusBarTint
   293	        dimmed={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   294	      />
   295	      <AndroidNavigationBarTint
   296	        dimStatusBar={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   297	        pathname={pathname}
   298	      />
   299	    </View>
   300	  );
   301	}
   302	
   303	export default function RootLayout() {
   304	  const headerScrollY = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   305

    31	function isMatchingLayout(currentLayout, nextLayout) {
    32	  return (
    33	    currentLayout &&
    34	    Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
    35	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
    36	  );
    37	}

    39	export default function HomeScreen() {
    40	  const [imageLayouts, setImageLayouts] = useState({});
    41	  const [paragraphLayouts, setParagraphLayouts] = useState({});
    42	  const {
    43	    compactTopLayout,
    44	    initialContentOffset,
    45	    scrollContentInsetStyle,

    54	  const passionImageBlendTranslateY = scrollY.interpolate({
    55	    inputRange: [0, passionImageBlendScrollDistance],
    56	    outputRange: [-passionImageBlendFeatherHeight, croppedImageHeight],
    57	    extrapolate: "clamp",
    58	  });
    59	  const handleParagraphLayout = useCallback(
    60	    (featureName) =>

    64	
    65	        setParagraphLayouts((currentLayouts) => {
    66	          if (isMatchingLayout(currentLayouts[featureName], nextLayout)) {
    67	            return currentLayouts;
    68	          }
    69	
    70	          return {
    71	            ...currentLayouts,
    72	            [featureName]: nextLayout,
    73	          };
    74	        });
    75	      },
    76	    []
    77	  );
    78	  const handleImageLayout = useCallback(
    79	    (featureName) =>
    80	      ({ nativeEvent }) => {
    81	        const { height, y } = nativeEvent.layout;
    82	        const nextLayout = { height, y };
    83	
    84	        setImageLayouts((currentLayouts) => {
    85	          if (isMatchingLayout(currentLayouts[featureName], nextLayout)) {
    86	            return currentLayouts;
    87	          }
    88	
    89	          return {
    90	            ...currentLayouts,
    91	            [featureName]: nextLayout,
    92	          };
    93	        });
    94	      },
    95	    []
    96	  );

   194	function ProductMagnifySection({ croppedImageWidth, onBuyPress, product, scrollY }) {
   195	  const [buyButtonLayout, setBuyButtonLayout] = useState(null);
   196	  const [imageLayout, setImageLayout] = useState(null);
   197	  const [lowerContentLayout, setLowerContentLayout] = useState(null);
   198	
   199	  const updateLayout = useCallback((setter) => ({ nativeEvent }) => {
   200	    const nextLayout = nativeEvent.layout;
   201	
   202	    setter((currentLayout) => {
   203	      if (
   204	        currentLayout &&
   205	        Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
   206	        Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
   207	      ) {
   208	        return currentLayout;
   209	      }
   210	
   211	      return nextLayout;
   212	    });
   213	  }, []);
   214	
   215	  return (
   216	    <CenterMagnifyView
   217	      magnifyEnterAnchorLayout={imageLayout}
   218	      magnifyExitAnchorLayout={buyButtonLayout || lowerContentLayout}
   219	      scrollY={scrollY}
   220	      style={productsStyles.productSectionWrap}
   221	    >
   222	      <ProductSection
   223	        croppedImageWidth={croppedImageWidth}
   224	        onBuyButtonLayout={updateLayout(setBuyButtonLayout)}
   225	        onBuyPress={onBuyPress}
   226	        onImageLayout={updateLayout(setImageLayout)}
   227	        onLowerContentLayout={updateLayout(setLowerContentLayout)}
   228	        product={product}
   229	      />
   230	    </CenterMagnifyView>
   231	  );
   232	}

    13	const featureImageAspectRatio = 1280 / 853;
    14	const aboutFeatureMagnifiedScale = 1.08;
    15	const aboutFeatureMagnifyRampViewportRatio = 0.5;
    16	
    17	function isMatchingLayout(currentLayout, nextLayout) {
    18	  return (
    19	    currentLayout &&
    20	    Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
    21	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
    22	  );
    23	}
    24	
    25	export default function AboutusScreen() {
    26	  const [sectionLayouts, setSectionLayouts] = useState({});
    27	  const {
    28	    compactTopLayout,
    29	    initialContentOffset,
    30	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
    31	    scrollHandlers,
    32	    scrollY,
    33	  } =
    34	    useMainScreenScrollProps();
    35	  const screenSwipeHandlers = useMainScreenSwipeNavigation();
    36	  const { width: windowWidth } = useWindowDimensions();
    37	  const croppedImageWidth = getFeatureImageWidth(windowWidth);
    38	  const croppedImageHeight = croppedImageWidth * featureImageAspectRatio;
    39	  const handleSectionLayout = useCallback(
    40	    (sectionName) =>
    41	      ({ nativeEvent }) => {
    42	        const { height, y } = nativeEvent.layout;
    43	        const nextLayout = { height, y };
    44	
    45	        setSectionLayouts((currentLayouts) => {
    46	          if (isMatchingLayout(currentLayouts[sectionName], nextLayout)) {
    47	            return currentLayouts;
    48	          }
    49	
    50	          return {
    51	            ...currentLayouts,
    52	            [sectionName]: nextLayout,
    53	          };
    54	        });
    55	      },
    56	    []
    57	  );
    58	
    59	  return (
    60	    <View style={aboutusStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
    61	      <Animated.ScrollView
    62	        style={aboutusStyles.scroll}
    63	        contentContainerStyle={[
    64	          aboutusStyles.scrollContent,
    65	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
    66	        ]}
    67	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
    68	        decelerationRate={0.95}
    69	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
    70	        scrollEventThrottle={16}

    85	            magnifyRampViewportRatio={aboutFeatureMagnifyRampViewportRatio}
    86	            magnifiedScale={aboutFeatureMagnifiedScale}
    87	            scrollY={scrollY}
    88	            style={aboutusStyles.aboutSection}

FILE: mob/app/contact.js

     1	import { useState } from "react";
     2	import { Alert, Animated, Text, TextInput, View } from "react-native";
     3	
     4	import CenterMagnifyView from "../components/CenterMagnifyView";
     5	import HapticPressable from "../components/HapticPressable";
     6	import MainScreenIntroSpacer from "../components/MainScreenIntroSpacer";
     7	import contactStyles from "../styles/contactStyles";
     8	import { sendContactMessage } from "../utils/contactMessages";
     9	import { useMainScreenScrollProps } from "../utils/mainScreenScrollContext";
    10	import { getMainScreenScrollViewProps } from "../utils/platformLayout";
    11	import useMainScreenSwipeNavigation from "../utils/useMainScreenSwipeNavigation";
    12	
    13	export default function ContactScreen() {
    14	  const [name, setName] = useState("");
    15	  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
    16	  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
    17	  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
    18	  const [emptyTouchedFieldKeys, setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys] = useState({});
    19	  const [blurredFieldKeys, setBlurredFieldKeys] = useState({});
    20	  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);
    21	  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState("");
    22	  const {
    23	    compactTopLayout,
    24	    initialContentOffset,
    25	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
    26	    scrollHandlers,
    27	    scrollY,
    28	  } =
    29	    useMainScreenScrollProps();
    30	  const screenSwipeHandlers = useMainScreenSwipeNavigation();
    31	  const trimmedName = name.trim();
    32	  const trimmedEmail = email.trim();
    33	  const trimmedMessage = message.trim();
    34	  const isEmailValid = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmedEmail);
    35	  const canSubmit =
    36	    trimmedName.length > 0 &&
    37	    isEmailValid &&
    38	    trimmedMessage.length > 0 &&
    39	    !isSending;
    40	
    41	  const contactFieldValues = {
    42	    email,
    43	    message,
    44	    name,
    45	    phone,
    46	  };
    47	  const shouldShowFieldFault = (fieldKey) =>
    48	    Boolean(emptyTouchedFieldKeys[fieldKey]) ||
    49	    (fieldKey === "email" &&
    50	      Boolean(blurredFieldKeys.email) &&
    51	      trimmedEmail.length > 0 &&
    52	      !isEmailValid);
    53	
    54	  const clearFieldFault = (fieldKey) => {
    55	    setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    56	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    57	        return currentFieldKeys;
    58	      }
    59	
    60	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    61	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    62	      return nextFieldKeys;
    63	    });
    64	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    65	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    66	        return currentFieldKeys;
    67	      }
    68	
    69	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    70	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    71	      return nextFieldKeys;
    72	    });
    73	  };
    74	
    75	  const markFieldBlurred = (fieldKey) => {
    76	    const fieldValue = contactFieldValues[fieldKey] || "";
    77	
    78	    setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
    79	      ...currentFieldKeys,
    80	      [fieldKey]: true,
    81	    }));
    82	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    83	      const isFieldEmpty = fieldValue.trim().length === 0;
    84	
    85	      if (isFieldEmpty) {
    86	        return {
    87	          ...currentFieldKeys,
    88	          [fieldKey]: true,
    89	        };
    90	      }
    91	
    92	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    93	        return currentFieldKeys;
    94	      }
    95	
    96	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    97	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    98	      return nextFieldKeys;
    99	    });
   100	  };
   101	
   102	  const updateContactField = (fieldKey, text, setter) => {
   103	    setter(text);
   104	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
   105	      if (text.trim().length === 0 || !currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
   106	        return currentFieldKeys;
   107	      }
   108	
   109	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
   110	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
   111	      return nextFieldKeys;
   112	    });
   113	  };
   114	
   115	  const showContactAlert = (title, alertMessage) => {
   116	    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.alert === "function") {
   117	      window.alert(`${title}\n${alertMessage}`);
   118	      return;
   119	    }
   120	
   121	    Alert.alert(title, alertMessage);
   122	  };
   123	
   124	  const handleSubmit = async () => {
   125	    if (!canSubmit) {
   126	      setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   127	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   128	        email: true,
   129	      }));
   130	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   131	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   132	        ...(trimmedName.length === 0 ? { name: true } : {}),
   133	        ...(trimmedEmail.length === 0 ? { email: true } : {}),
   134	        ...(trimmedMessage.length === 0 ? { message: true } : {}),
   135	      }));
   136	      setStatusMessage("Please enter your name, email, and message.");
   137	      return;
   138	    }
   139	
   140	    setIsSending(true);
   141	    setStatusMessage("");
   142	
   143	    try {
   144	      await sendContactMessage({
   145	        email: trimmedEmail,
   146	        message: trimmedMessage,
   147	        name: trimmedName,
   148	        phone: phone.trim(),
   149	      });
   150	      setName("");
   151	      setEmail("");
   152	      setPhone("");
   153	      setMessage("");
   154	      setBlurredFieldKeys({});
   155	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys({});
   156	      setStatusMessage("Message sent. We will respond within 48 hours.");
   157	      showContactAlert(
   158	        "Message sent",
   159	        "Thank you. Your message was sent to Alla Vostra.",
   160	      );
   161	    } catch (error) {
   162	      const errorMessage = error?.message || "Please try again.";
   163	      setStatusMessage(errorMessage);
   164	      showContactAlert("Message not sent", errorMessage);
   165	    } finally {
   166	      setIsSending(false);
   167	    }
   168	  };
   169	
   170	  return (
   171	    <View style={contactStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
   172	      <Animated.ScrollView
   173	        style={contactStyles.scroll}
   174	        contentContainerStyle={[
   175	          contactStyles.scrollContent,
   176	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
   177	        ]}
   178	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
   179	        decelerationRate={0.95}
   180	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
   181	        scrollEventThrottle={16}
   182	        {...getMainScreenScrollViewProps()}
   183	        {...screenSwipeHandlers}
   184	        {...scrollHandlers}
   185	      >
   186	        <View style={contactStyles.main}>
   187	          <MainScreenIntroSpacer
   188	            compactTopLayout={compactTopLayout}
   189	            pageTitleStyle={contactStyles.pageTitle}
   190	            scrollY={scrollY}
   191	          />
   192	
   193	          <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   194	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>Got a business inquiry?</Text>
   195	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   196	              General questions about our products?
   197	            </Text>
   198	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   199	              We strive to respond within 48 hours.
   200	            </Text>
   201	          </CenterMagnifyView>
   202	
   203	          <View style={contactStyles.formCard}>
   204	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   205	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Full Name</Text>
   206	              <TextInput
   207	                style={[
   208	                  contactStyles.input,
   209	                  shouldShowFieldFault("name") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   210	                ]}
   211	                placeholder="Your Name"
   212	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   213	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("name")}
   214	                onChangeText={(text) => updateContactField("name", text, setName)}
   215	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("name")}
   216	                returnKeyType="next"
   217	                textContentType="name"
   218	                value={name}
   219	              />
   220	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   221	
   222	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   223	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Email Address</Text>
   224	              <TextInput
   225	                style={[
   226	                  contactStyles.input,
   227	                  shouldShowFieldFault("email") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   228	                ]}
   229	                placeholder="you@company.com"
   230	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   231	                keyboardType="email-address"
   232	                autoCapitalize="none"
   233	                autoCorrect={false}
   234	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("email")}
   235	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   236	                  updateContactField("email", text, setEmail)
   237	                }
   238	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("email")}
   239	                returnKeyType="next"
   240	                textContentType="emailAddress"
   241	                value={email}
   242	              />
   243	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   244	
   245	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   246	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Phone Number</Text>
   247	              <TextInput
   248	                style={[
   249	                  contactStyles.input,
   250	                  shouldShowFieldFault("phone") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   251	                ]}
   252	                placeholder="+1 (555) 1234-567"
   253	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   254	                keyboardType="phone-pad"
   255	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("phone")}
   256	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   257	                  updateContactField("phone", text, setPhone)
   258	                }
   259	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("phone")}
   260	                returnKeyType="next"
   261	                textContentType="telephoneNumber"
   262	                value={phone}
   263	              />
   264	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   265	
   266	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   267	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Your Message</Text>
   268	              <TextInput
   269	                style={[
   270	                  contactStyles.input,
   271	                  contactStyles.messageInput,
   272	                  shouldShowFieldFault("message") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   273	                ]}
   274	                placeholder="Your Message"
   275	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   276	                multiline
   277	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("message")}
   278	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   279	                  updateContactField("message", text, setMessage)
   280	                }
   281	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("message")}
   282	                returnKeyType="default"
   283	                textAlignVertical="top"
   284	                value={message}
   285	              />
   286	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   287	
   288	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY} style={contactStyles.buttonWrap}>
   289	              <HapticPressable
   290	                accessibilityRole="button"

   297	              >

   299	                  {isSending ? "Sending..." : "Send Message"}
   300	                </Text>

   302	              {statusMessage ? (

   306	          </View>
   307	        </View>

   103	  const rawValue = Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value;
   104	  const requestedName = String(rawValue || "").trim();
   105	
   106	  if (!requestedName) {

   113	  );
   114

   900	function PiccolaQuantityTriangle({ direction, muted }) {
   901	  const strokeInset = piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleStrokeWidth / 2;
   902	  const strokeColor = muted ? "#888888" : "#111111";
   903	  const isUpTriangle = direction === "up";
   904	  const fillGradientId = isUpTriangle
   905	    ? "piccolaQuantityTriangleTopGradient"
   906	    : "piccolaQuantityTriangleBottomGradient";
   907	  const fillGradientColors = isUpTriangle
   908	    ? topOverlayGradientColors
   909	    : orangeButtonGradientColors;
   910	  const path =
   911	    isUpTriangle
   912	      ? [
   913	          `M ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2} ${strokeInset}`,
   914	          `L ${
   915	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth - strokeInset
   916	          } ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset}`,
   917	          `L ${strokeInset} ${
   918	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset
   919	          }`,
   920	          "Z",
   921	        ].join(" ")
   922	      : [
   923	          `M ${strokeInset} ${strokeInset}`,
   924	          `L ${
   925	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth - strokeInset
   926	          } ${strokeInset}`,
   927	          `L ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2} ${
   928	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset
   929	          }`,
   930	          "Z",
   931	        ].join(" ");
   932	
   933	  return (
   934	    <Svg
   935	      height="100%"
   936	      style={shopStyles.piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleSvg}
   937	      viewBox={`0 0 ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth} ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight}`}
   938	      width="100%"
   939	    >
   940	      <Defs>
   941	        <SvgLinearGradient
   942	          gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
   943	          id={fillGradientId}
   944	          x1={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2}
   945	          x2={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2}
   946	          y1={isUpTriangle ? piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight : 0}
   947	          y2={isUpTriangle ? 0 : piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight}
   948	        >
   949	          {fillGradientColors.map((color, index) => (
   950	            <Stop
   951	              key={`${fillGradientId}-${color}`}
   952	              offset={`${index * 50}%`}
   953	              stopColor={color}
   954	            />
   955	          ))}
   956	        </SvgLinearGradient>
   957	      </Defs>
   958	      <Path
   959	        d={path}
   960	        fill={`url(#${fillGradientId})`}
   961	        opacity={muted ? 0.5 : 1}
   962	        stroke={strokeColor}
   963	        strokeLinejoin="round"
   964	        strokeWidth={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleStrokeWidth}
   965	      />
   966	    </Svg>
   967	  );
   968	}

  3834	  const handleOrderConfirmationYesPress = async () => {
  3835	    if (isStripePaymentInFlight) return;
  3836	
  3837	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
  3838	      showPaymentAlert(
  3839	        "Payment unavailable",
  3840	        "Stripe payments are available in the mobile app build.",
  3841	      );
  3842	      return;
  3843	    }
  3844	
  3845	    const configurationIssue = getStripeConfigurationIssue();
  3846	
  3847	    if (configurationIssue) {
  3848	      showPaymentAlert("Stripe setup needed", configurationIssue);
  3849	      return;
  3850	    }
  3851	
  3852	    if (
  3853	      selectedPaymentOverlayMethod !== paymentOverlayCardMethod &&
  3854	      selectedPaymentOverlayMethod !== paymentOverlayGooglePayMethod &&
  3855	      selectedPaymentOverlayMethod !== paymentOverlayApplePayMethod
  3856	    ) {
  3857	      showPaymentAlert(
  3858	        "Payment method unavailable",
  3859	        "Use Debit/Credit Card, Google Pay, or Apple Pay for this Stripe checkout.",
  3860	      );
  3861	      return;
  3862	    }
  3863	
  3864	    if (selectedPaymentOverlayMethod === paymentOverlayApplePayMethod) {
  3865	      if (Platform.OS !== "ios") {
  3866	        showPaymentAlert(
  3867	          "Apple Pay unavailable",
  3868	          "Apple Pay is only available on iPhone. Use Debit/Credit Card or Google Pay on this device.",
  3869	        );
  3870	        return;
  3871	      }
  3872	
  3873	      if (isExpoGo) {
  3874	        showPaymentAlert(
  3875	          "Apple Pay needs a development build",
  3876	          "Expo Go cannot open the native Apple Pay sheet. Use an iOS development build or App Store build to test Apple Pay.",
  3877	        );
  3878	        return;
  3879	      }
  3880	
  3881	      if (!stripeMerchantIdentifier) {
  3882	        showPaymentAlert(
  3883	          "Apple Pay setup needed",
  3884	          "Add EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_MERCHANT_IDENTIFIER to mob/.env so StripeProvider can use your Apple merchant ID.",
  3885	        );
  3886	        return;
  3887	      }
  3888	
  3889	      if (!isApplePaySupported) {
  3890	        showPaymentAlert(
  3891	          "Apple Pay unavailable",
  3892	          "This iPhone is not ready for Apple Pay. Make sure Wallet has an active card, then try again.",
  3893	        );
  3894	        return;
  3895	      }
  3896	    } else if (selectedPaymentOverlayMethod === paymentOverlayGooglePayMethod) {
  3897	      if (Platform.OS !== "android") {
  3898	        showPaymentAlert(
  3899	          "Google Pay unavailable",
  3900	          "Google Pay is only available on Android. Use Debit/Credit Card on this device.",
  3901	        );
  3902	        return;
  3903	      }
  3904	
  3905	      if (isExpoGo) {
  3906	        showPaymentAlert(
  3907	          "Google Pay needs a development build",
  3908	          "Expo Go cannot open the native Google Pay sheet. Use an Android development build or Play Store build to test Google Pay.",
  3909	        );
  3910	        return;
  3911	      }
  3912	
  3913	      if (!isGooglePaySupported) {
  3914	        showPaymentAlert(
  3915	          "Google Pay unavailable",
  3916	          "This device is not ready for Google Pay. Make sure Google Wallet is set up, then try again.",
  3917	        );
  3918	        return;
  3919	      }
  3920	    } else if (
  3921	      !isPaymentCardAccepted ||
  3922	      !stripeCardDetails?.complete ||
  3923	      !acceptedStripePaymentMethodId
  3924	    ) {
  3925	      showPaymentAlert(
  3926	        "Card details needed",
  3927	        "Enter a complete card number, expiration date, and CVV.",
  3928	      );
  3929	      return;
  3930	    }
  3931	
  3932	    const orderPayload = buildStripeOrderPayload();
  3933	
  3934	    if (orderPayload.items.length === 0) {
  3935	      showPaymentAlert("Cart is empty", "Add an item before placing an order.");
  3936	      return;
  3937	    }
  3938	
  3939	    setIsStripePaymentInFlight(true);
  3940	
  3941	    try {
  3942	      const paymentSheet = await createStripePaymentSheet(orderPayload);
  3943	      if (selectedPaymentOverlayMethod === paymentOverlayApplePayMethod) {
  3944	        await confirmApplePayPayment(
  3945	          paymentSheet.paymentIntentClientSecret,
  3946	          paymentSheet,
  3947	        );
  3948	      } else if (selectedPaymentOverlayMethod === paymentOverlayGooglePayMethod) {
  3949	        await confirmGooglePayPayment(paymentSheet.paymentIntentClientSecret);
  3950	      } else {
  3951	        const confirmResult = await confirmPayment(
  3952	          paymentSheet.paymentIntentClientSecret,
  3953	          {
  3954	            paymentMethodType: "Card",
  3955	            paymentMethodData: {
  3956	              billingDetails: buildStripeBillingDetails(),
  3957	              paymentMethodId: acceptedStripePaymentMethodId,
  3958	            },
  3959	          },
  3960	        );
  3961	
  3962	        if (confirmResult.error) {
  3963	          throw new Error(
  3964	            confirmResult.error.localizedMessage ||
  3965	              confirmResult.error.message ||
  3966	              "Payment was not completed.",
  3967	          );
  3968	        }
  3969	
  3970	        if (
  3971	          confirmResult.paymentIntent?.status &&
  3972	          !["Succeeded", "Processing"].includes(
  3973	            confirmResult.paymentIntent.status,
  3974	          )
  3975	        ) {
  3976	          throw new Error(
  3977	            `Payment status is ${confirmResult.paymentIntent.status}. Please try again.`,
  3978	          );
  3979	        }
  3980	      }
  3981	
  3982	      showOrderPlacementConfirmation();
  3983	    } catch (error) {
  3984	      showPaymentAlert(
  3985	        "Payment not completed",
  3986	        error?.message || "Please try again.",
  3987	      );
  3988	    } finally {
  3989	      setIsStripePaymentInFlight(false);
  3990	    }
  3991	  };

    94	function getActivePageFromPath(pathname) {
    95	  if (pathname === "/products") return "products";
    96	  if (pathname === "/aboutus") return "aboutus";
    97	  if (pathname === "/contact") return "contact";
    98	  if (pathname === "/shop") return "shop";
    99	  return "home";

   101	
   102	function getNavigationDirection(fromPage, toPage) {
   103	  const fromIndex = navPages.indexOf(fromPage);
   104	  const toIndex = navPages.indexOf(toPage);
   105	
   106	  if (fromIndex < 0 || toIndex < 0 || fromIndex === toIndex) return 1;
   107	
   108	  const lastPageIndex = navPages.length - 1;
   109	
   110	  if (fromIndex === lastPageIndex && toIndex === 0) return 1;
   111	  if (fromIndex === 0 && toIndex === lastPageIndex) return -1;
   112	
   113	  return toIndex > fromIndex ? 1 : -1;
   114	}

   169	  const resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY = shouldFreezeHeaderMotion
   170	    ? frozenHeaderMotionScrollY
   171	    : headerMotionScrollY;
   172	
   173	  const fallbackHeldArrowOpacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   174	  const fallbackRouteTransitionProgress = useRef(
   175	    new Animated.Value(0)
   176	  ).current;
   177	  const heldArrowOpacity =

   179	  const routeTransitionProgress =

   182	  const fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity = useRef(
   183	    new Animated.Value(0)
   184	  ).current;
   185	  const fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity = useRef(
   186	    new Animated.Value(0)

   194	  const directionalRightArrowOpacity =

   197	  const directionalArrowBaseSuppression =
   198	    screenSwipe?.directionalArrowBaseSuppression ||
   199	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression;
   200	
   201	  const indicatorAnimationRef = useRef(null);

   203	  const suppressCarouselPressUntilRef = useRef(0);
   204	  const canNavigateWithHeaderRef = useRef(canNavigateWithHeader);
   205	
   206	  const activePageRef = useRef(resolvedActivePage);
   207	  const activeIndexRef = useRef(activePageIndex);

   209	  activePageRef.current = resolvedActivePage;
   210	  activeIndexRef.current = activePageIndex;
   211	
   212	  useEffect(() => {

   216	      cheeseboardProductsImage

   220	      Image.prefetch(resolvedCheeseboardImage.uri).catch(() => {});

   223	
   224	  const showHeldArrows = (event = null) => {

   227	      return;
   228	    }

   231	    fallbackHeldArrowOpacity.setValue(arrowHintPeakOpacity);
   232	  };
   233

   235	    if (screenSwipe?.hideHeldArrowHint) {
   236	      screenSwipe.hideHeldArrowHint();
   237	      return;
   238	    }
   239	
   240	    fallbackHeldArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   241	    fallbackHeldArrowOpacity.setValue(0);
   242	  };
   243	
   244	  const cancelHeldArrows = () => {
   245	    if (screenSwipe?.cancelHeldArrowHint) {
   246	      screenSwipe.cancelHeldArrowHint();
   247	      return;
   248	    }
   249	
   250	    hideHeldArrows();
   251	  };
   252	
   253	  const updateHeldArrowsFromTouchMove = (event) => {
   254	    screenSwipe?.updateHeldArrowHintMovement?.(event);
   255	    return false;

   257

   259	    if (screenSwipe?.clearDirectionalArrowLinger) {
   260	      screenSwipe.clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   261	      return;
   262	    }
   263	
   264	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   265	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   266	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.stopAnimation();
   267	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.setValue(0);
   268	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.setValue(0);
   269	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.setValue(0);
   270	  };
   271	
   272	  const startDirectionalArrowLinger = (direction) => {
   273	    if (screenSwipe?.startDirectionalArrowLinger) {
   274	      screenSwipe.startDirectionalArrowLinger(direction);
   275	      return;
   276	    }
   277	
   278	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   279	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   280	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.stopAnimation();
   281	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.setValue(1);
   282	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.setValue(
   283	      direction === "left" ? arrowHintPeakOpacity : 0

   285	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.setValue(
   286	      direction === "right" ? arrowHintPeakOpacity : 0
   287	    );
   288	  };
   289	
   290	  const updateSwipePreview = (dragDistance) => {
   291	    if (!screenSwipe) return;
   292	
   293	    screenSwipe.updateSwipe({
   294	      x: dragDistance,
   295	    });
   296	  };
   297	
   298	  const animateIndicatorBetweenIndexes = (fromIndex, toIndex) => {
   299	    if (fromIndex === toIndex) {
   300	      if (!indicatorAnimationRef.current) {
   301	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   302	      }
   303	      return;
   304	    }
   305	
   306	    if (indicatorAnimationRef.current) {
   307	      const previousAnimation = indicatorAnimationRef.current;
   308	      indicatorAnimationRef.current = null;
   309	      previousAnimation.stop();
   310	    }
   311	
   312	    indicatorIndexRef.current = toIndex;
   313	
   314	    const createIndicatorTiming = (toValue, duration = indicatorSlideDuration) =>
   315	      Animated.timing(indicatorProgress, {
   316	        toValue,
   317	        duration,
   318	        useNativeDriver: true,
   319	      });
   320	
   321	    const lastPageIndex = navPages.length - 1;
   322	    const animation =
   323	      fromIndex === lastPageIndex && toIndex === 0
   324	        ? Animated.sequence([
   325	            createIndicatorTiming(navPages.length),
   326	            createIndicatorTiming(-1, 0),
   327	            createIndicatorTiming(toIndex),
   328	          ])
   329	        : fromIndex === 0 && toIndex === lastPageIndex
   330	        ? Animated.sequence([
   331	            createIndicatorTiming(-1),
   332	            createIndicatorTiming(navPages.length, 0),
   333	            createIndicatorTiming(toIndex),
   334	          ])
   335	        : createIndicatorTiming(toIndex);
   336	
   337	    indicatorAnimationRef.current = animation;
   338	
   339	    animation.start(({ finished }) => {
   340	      if (finished) {
   341	        indicatorIndexRef.current = toIndex;
   342	      }
   343	
   344	      if (indicatorAnimationRef.current === animation) {
   345	        indicatorAnimationRef.current = null;
   346	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   347	      }
   348	    });
   349	  };
   350	
   351	  useEffect(() => {
   352	    animateIndicatorBetweenIndexes(indicatorIndexRef.current, activePageIndex);
   353	  }, [activePageIndex, indicatorProgress]);
   354	
   355	  const animateIndicatorToPage = (pageName) => {
   356	    const pageIndex = navPages.indexOf(pageName);
   357	    if (pageIndex < 0) return;
   358	
   359	    animateIndicatorBetweenIndexes(activeIndexRef.current, pageIndex);
   360	  };
   361	
   362	  const goToPage = (pageName, animateIndicator = true) => {
   363	    hideHeldArrows();
   364	
   365	    if (pageName === activePageRef.current) {
   366	      if (pageName === "shop") {
   367	        goToPage("home", animateIndicator);
   368	      }
   369	
   370	      return;
   371	    }
   372	
   373	    const route = pageRoutes[pageName];
   374	    if (!route) return;
   375	
   376	    if (navPages.includes(pageName)) {
   377	      if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) {
   378	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   379	        screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   380	        return;
   381	      }
   382	
   383	      backgroundHeroState?.freezeHero(safeScrollY);
   384	      if (animateIndicator) animateIndicatorToPage(pageName);
   385	      router.replace(route);
   386	      return;
   387	    }
   388	
   389	    router.push(route);
   390	  };
   391	
   392	  const goToPreviousPage = () => {
   393	    if (Date.now() < suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current) return;
   394	
   395	    const previousIndex =
   396	      (activeIndexRef.current + navPages.length - 1) % navPages.length;
   397	
   398	    goToPage(navPages[previousIndex], true, -1);
   399	  };
   400	
   401	  const goToNextPage = () => {
   402	    if (Date.now() < suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current) return;
   403	
   404	    const nextIndex = (activeIndexRef.current + 1) % navPages.length;
   405	
   406	    goToPage(navPages[nextIndex], true, 1);
   407	  };
   408	
   409	  const shouldClaimCarouselSwipe = (_, gestureState) => {
   410	    if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) return false;
   411	
   412	    const horizontalDistance = Math.abs(gestureState.dx);
   413	    const verticalDistance = Math.abs(gestureState.dy);
   414	
   415	    if (
   416	      horizontalDistance >= tapHoldHorizontalCancelDistance &&
   417	      horizontalDistance > verticalDistance * tapHoldHorizontalDominanceRatio
   418	    ) {
   419	      cancelHeldArrows();
   420	    }
   421	
   422	    const shouldClaim =
   423	      horizontalDistance > carouselSwipeActivationDistance &&
   424	      horizontalDistance > verticalDistance * carouselSwipeActivationRatio;
   425	
   426	    if (shouldClaim) {
   427	      cancelHeldArrows();
   428	    }
   429	
   430	    return shouldClaim;
   431	  };
   432	
   433	  const carouselPanResponder = useRef(
   434	    PanResponder.create({
   435	      onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: shouldClaimCarouselSwipe,
   436	
   437	      onMoveShouldSetPanResponderCapture: shouldClaimCarouselSwipe,
   438	
   439	      onPanResponderTerminationRequest: (_, gestureState) =>
   440	        !shouldClaimCarouselSwipe(null, gestureState),
   441	
   442	      onPanResponderMove: (_, gestureState) => {
   443	        if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) return;
   444	
   445	        suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current = Date.now() + 500;
   446	        updateSwipePreview(gestureState.dx);
   447	
   448	        if (gestureState.dx <= -carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   449	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("left");
   450	          return;
   451	        }
   452	
   453	        if (gestureState.dx >= carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   454	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("right");
   455	          return;
   456	        }
   457	
   458	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   459	      },
   460	
   461	      onPanResponderRelease: (_, gestureState) => {
   462	        suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current = Date.now() + 500;
   463	        hideHeldArrows();
   464	
   465	        if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) {
   466	          clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   467	          screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   468	          return;
   469	        }
   470	
   471	        if (gestureState.dx <= -carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   472	          const nextIndex = (activeIndexRef.current + 1) % navPages.length;
   473	          const nextPage = navPages[nextIndex];
   474	
   475	          updateSwipePreview(gestureState.dx);
   476	          screenSwipe?.commitSwipe({
   477	            x: gestureState.dx,
   478	            page: nextPage,
   479	            direction: 1,
   480	            fromPage: activePageRef.current,
   481	          });
   482	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("left");
   483	          goToPage(nextPage, true, 1);
   484	
   485	          return;
   486	        }
   487	
   488	        if (gestureState.dx >= carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   489	          const previousIndex =
   490	            (activeIndexRef.current + navPages.length - 1) % navPages.length;
   491	          const previousPage = navPages[previousIndex];
   492	
   493	          updateSwipePreview(gestureState.dx);
   494	          screenSwipe?.commitSwipe({
   495	            x: gestureState.dx,
   496	            page: previousPage,
   497	            direction: -1,
   498	            fromPage: activePageRef.current,
   499	          });
   500	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("right");
   501	          goToPage(previousPage, true, -1);
   502	
   503	          return;
   504	        }
   505	
   506	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   507	        screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   508	      },
   509	
   510	      onPanResponderTerminate: () => {
   511	        suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current = Date.now() + 500;
   512	        hideHeldArrows();
   513	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   514	        screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   515	      },
   516	
   517	      onShouldBlockNativeResponder: () => true,
   518	    })
   519	  ).current;
   520	
   521	  useEffect(() => {
   522	    hideHeldArrows();
   523	
   524	    return () => {
   525	      hideHeldArrows();
   526	    };
   527	  }, [resolvedActivePage, showCarousel, showOnlyHero]);
   528	
   529	  useEffect(
   530	    () => () => {
   531	      clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   532	    },
   533	    []
   534	  );
   535	
   536	  const activeLink = pageLabels[resolvedActivePage] || "Home";
   537	  const arrowLinkTranslateX = 0;
   538	
   539	  const scrollBeganArrowVisibility = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   540	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   541	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   542	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   543	  });
   544	  const oldHeaderArrowVisibility = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   545	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   546	    outputRange: [1, 0],
   547	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   548	  });
   549	  const oldHeaderHeldArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   550	    heldArrowOpacity.interpolate({
   551	      inputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   552	      outputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   553	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   554	    }),
   555	    oldHeaderArrowVisibility
   556	  );
   557	  const scrolledStateArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   558	    scrollBeganArrowVisibility,
   559	    arrowHintPeakOpacity
   560	  );
   561	  const scrolledVisibleArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   562	    heldArrowOpacity,
   563	    scrolledStateArrowOpacity
   564	  );
   565	  const gatedScrolledArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   566	    scrolledVisibleArrowOpacity.interpolate({
   567	      inputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   568	      outputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   569	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   570	    }),
   571	    scrollBeganArrowVisibility
   572	  );
   573	  const gatedVisibleArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   574	    oldHeaderHeldArrowOpacity,
   575	    gatedScrolledArrowOpacity
   576	  ).interpolate({
   577	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   578	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   579	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   580	  });
   581	  const directionalBaseArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   582	    gatedVisibleArrowOpacity,
   583	    directionalArrowBaseSuppression.interpolate({
   584	      inputRange: [0, 1],
   585	      outputRange: [1, 0],
   586	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   587	    })
   588	  );
   589	  const leftArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   590	    directionalBaseArrowOpacity,
   591	    directionalLeftArrowOpacity
   592	  ).interpolate({
   593	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   594	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   595	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   596	  });
   597	  const rightArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   598	    directionalBaseArrowOpacity,
   599	    directionalRightArrowOpacity
   600	  ).interpolate({
   601	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   602	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   603	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   604	  });
   605	
   606	  const heroVerticalFadeTranslateY = resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   607	    inputRange: [0, heroVerticalFadeScrollDistance],
   608	    outputRange: [heroVerticalFadeHeight, -heroVerticalFadeFeatherHeight],
   609	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   610	  });
   611	
   612	  const stickyOffset =
   613	    Platform.OS === "web"
   614	      ? 0
   615	      : resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   616	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   617	          outputRange: [0, carouselStickyOffsetY],
   618	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   619	        });
   620	  const carouselExpansionOffsetY =
   621	    Platform.OS === "ios"
   622	      ? resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   623	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   624	          outputRange: [0, carouselExpansionHeight],
   625	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   626	        })
   627	      : stickyOffset;
   628	  const carouselInnerTranslateY = carouselExpansionOffsetY;
   629	
   630	  const centerShadowOpacity =
   631	    Platform.OS === "web"
   632	      ? 1
   633	      : resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   634	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   635	          outputRange: [0, 1],
   636	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   637	        });
   638	
   639	  const stickyExpansionTranslateY = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   640	    inputRange: [96, 120],
   641	    outputRange: [-stickyExpansionMaxHeight, 0],
   642	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   643	  });
   644	
   645	  const heroScale = resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   646	    inputRange: [0, heroFadeScrollDistance],
   647	    outputRange: [heroStartScale, heroScaleAtMinimumOpacity],
   648	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   649	  });
   650	
   651	  const heroTranslateY = resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   652	    inputRange: [0, heroFadeScrollDistance],
   653	    outputRange: [heroStartTranslateY, heroTranslateYAtMinimumOpacity],
   654	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   655	  });
   656	
   657	  const headerTranslateY = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   658	    inputRange: [0, 120],
   659	    outputRange: [0, -120],
   660	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   661	  });
   662	
   663	  const indicatorSegmentWidth = windowWidth / navPages.length;
   664	  const indicatorTranslateX = Animated.multiply(
   665	    indicatorProgress,
   666	    indicatorSegmentWidth
   667	  );
   668	  const isMainHeroPage = navPages.includes(resolvedActivePage);
   669	  const heroImageSource = isMainHeroPage
   670	    ? noCheeseboardHeroImage
   671	    : defaultHeroImage;
   672	  const mainHeroVisualOpacity = isMainHeroPage
   673	    ? resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   674	        inputRange: [0, heroFadeScrollDistance],
   675	        outputRange: [1, heroMinimumScrollOpacity],
   676	        extrapolate: "clamp",
   677	      })
   678	    : 1;
   679	  const heroWidthFitScale = windowWidth / heroSourceWidth;
   680	  const heroWidthFitImageHeight = heroSourceHeight * heroWidthFitScale;
   681	  const heroImageFrameStyle = isMainHeroPage
   682	    ? {
   683	        width: windowWidth,
   684	        height: heroWidthFitImageHeight,
   685	      }
   686	    : null;
   687	  const heroImageTransformStyle = isMainHeroPage
   688	    ? null
   689	    : {
   690	        transform: [{ scale: heroScale }, { translateY: heroTranslateY }],
   691	      };
   692	  const heroImageOpacityStyle = isMainHeroPage
   693	    ? { opacity: mainHeroVisualOpacity }
   694	    : null;
   695	  const heroCoverScale = Math.max(
   696	    windowWidth / heroSourceWidth,
   697	    heroVerticalFadeHeight / heroSourceHeight
   698	  );
   699	  const heroLayoutScale = isMainHeroPage ? heroWidthFitScale : heroCoverScale;
   700	  const heroRenderedWidth = heroSourceWidth * heroLayoutScale;
   701	  const heroRenderedHeight = heroSourceHeight * heroLayoutScale;
   702	  const heroRenderedLeft = (windowWidth - heroRenderedWidth) / 2;
   703	  const heroRenderedTop = isMainHeroPage
   704	    ? 0
   705	    : (heroVerticalFadeHeight - heroRenderedHeight) / 2;
   706	  const noCheeseboardVisibleBottomY = Math.min(
   707	    heroVerticalFadeHeight,
   708	    heroRenderedTop + noCheeseboardVisibleBottomSourceY * heroLayoutScale
   709	  );
   710	  const cheeseboardWidth = cheeseboardSourceWidth * heroLayoutScale;
   711	  const cheeseboardHeight = cheeseboardSourceHeight * heroLayoutScale;
   712	  const cheeseboardLeft =
   713	    heroRenderedLeft + cheeseboardSourceX * heroLayoutScale;
   714	  const cheeseboardTop = isMainHeroPage
   715	    ? noCheeseboardVisibleBottomY - cheeseboardHeight / 2
   716	    : heroRenderedTop + cheeseboardSourceY * heroLayoutScale;
   717	  const routeTransitionState = screenSwipe?.routeTransitionState;
   718	  const isCheeseboardNavigationMotionDisabled =
   719	    isMainHeroPage && isHeaderNewState(resolvedHeroMotionScrollY);
   720	  const isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive =
   721	    isMainHeroPage &&
   722	    !isCheeseboardNavigationMotionDisabled &&
   723	    Boolean(routeTransitionState?.isActive);
   724	  const isCheeseboardSwipeActive =
   725	    isMainHeroPage &&
   726	    !isCheeseboardNavigationMotionDisabled &&
   727	    Boolean(screenSwipe?.isActive);
   728	  const cheeseboardTransitionDirection =
   729	    routeTransitionState?.direction === -1 ? -1 : 1;
   730	  const cheeseboardTransitionStartX =
   731	    typeof routeTransitionState?.startX === "number"
   732	      ? routeTransitionState.startX
   733	      : 0;
   734	  const cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX =
   735	    Platform.OS === "ios" ? 0.01 : 0;
   736	  const cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX =
   737	    Math.abs(cheeseboardTransitionStartX) > 0.01
   738	      ? cheeseboardTransitionStartX
   739	      : cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX;
   740	  const cheeseboardHiddenHandoffOpacity =
   741	    Platform.OS === "ios" ? 0.001 : 0;
   742	  const cheeseboardDragTranslateX = isCheeseboardSwipeActive
   743	    ? screenSwipe?.swipeX || 0
   744	    : 0;
   745	  const cheeseboardBaseTranslateX = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   746	    ? 0
   747	    : cheeseboardDragTranslateX;
   748	  const cheeseboardBaseOpacity = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   749	    ? routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   750	        inputRange: [0, 0.92, 1],
   751	        outputRange: [
   752	          cheeseboardHiddenHandoffOpacity,
   753	          cheeseboardHiddenHandoffOpacity,
   754	          1,
   755	        ],
   756	        extrapolate: "clamp",
   757	      })
   758	    : 1;
   759	  const cheeseboardOutgoingTranslateX = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   760	    ? routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   761	        inputRange: [0, 1],
   762	        outputRange: [
   763	          cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX,
   764	          -cheeseboardTransitionDirection * windowWidth,
   765	        ],
   766	        extrapolate: "clamp",
   767	      })
   768	    : cheeseboardDragTranslateX;
   769	  const cheeseboardIncomingTranslateX = routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   770	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   771	    outputRange: [
   772	      cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX +
   773	        cheeseboardTransitionDirection * windowWidth,
   774	      cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX,
   775	    ],
   776	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   777	  });
   778	  const cheeseboardIncomingOpacity = routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({

FILE: mob/components/PageDivider.js

     1	import { Animated } from "react-native";
     2	
     3	import sharedStyles from "../styles/sharedStyles";
     4	
     5	const topDividerFadeScrollDistance = 240;
     6	
     7	export default function PageDivider({
     8	  expandedSpacing = false,
     9	  fadeScrollDistance = topDividerFadeScrollDistance,
    10	  fadeWithScrollY = null,
    11	}) {
    12	  const fadeOpacity = fadeWithScrollY?.interpolate({
    13	    inputRange: [0, fadeScrollDistance],
    14	    outputRange: [1, 0],
    15	    extrapolate: "clamp",
    16	  });
    17	
    18	  return (
    19	    <Animated.View
    20	      style={[
    21	        sharedStyles.pageDivider,
    22	        expandedSpacing && sharedStyles.expandedPageDivider,
    23	        fadeOpacity && { opacity: fadeOpacity },
    24	      ]}
    25	    />
    26	  );
    27	}

FILE: mob/utils/headerScrollContext.js
============================================================

     1	import { createContext, useContext } from "react";
     2	
     3	const HeaderScrollContext = createContext(null);
     4	
     5	export function HeaderScrollProvider({ children, scrollY }) {
     6	  return (
     7	    <HeaderScrollContext.Provider value={scrollY}>
     8	      {children}
     9	    </HeaderScrollContext.Provider>
    10	  );
    11	}
    12	
    13	export function useHeaderScrollY() {
    14	  return useContext(HeaderScrollContext);
    15	}

============================================================
FILE: mob/utils/openPaymentLink.js
============================================================

     1	import { Alert, Linking, Platform } from "react-native";
     2	
     3	export async function openPaymentLink(url) {
     4	  if (!url) {
     5	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
     6	      window.alert("No payment link has been added for this product yet.");
     7	      return;
     8	    }
     9	
    10	    Alert.alert("Payment link missing", "No payment link has been added yet.");
    11	    return;
    12	  }
    13	
    14	  try {
    15	    const canOpen = await Linking.canOpenURL(url);
    16	
    17	    if (!canOpen) {
    18	      throw new Error("Cannot open URL");
    19	    }
    20	
    21	    await Linking.openURL(url);
    22	  } catch (error) {
    23	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
    24	      window.alert("Unable to open this payment link.");
    25	      return;
    26	    }
    27	
    28	    Alert.alert("Unable to open link", "Please try again later.");
    29	  }
    30	}
